transcript.answer: Lore's agent pods run on the external floor (re-cinq/floor). The floor's own cluster agent runs each agent in a Kubernetes pod, and Lore's stations service only does the deterministic steps. Lore holds no Kubernetes client of its own. Lore used to run its own Floor and cluster agent, but they were deleted on 2026-10-02. The old LoreTask CRD, controller and claude-runner path was removed before that. Lore's own long-running `lore-agent` coordinator and its Kubernetes CronJobs still run on GKE. The coordinator is not what launches agent pods.
